purpose: Synthetic cases with stipulated answers. They check that the instrument can represent and compute each case; they decide no real case. Neutral names only; nothing here is from the packet. Given to readers only apart from, or after locking, their real-source responses (M01_EXTENSION.md section 4).

rule_under_test.TAG: the field is present on every instance of the target and on no instance of any other term
rule_under_test.INDEPENDENCE: the field is not listed in the case's computed_from map (it is passed in or recorded raw)
rule_under_test.slot_under_this_rule: TAG and INDEPENDENCE; this is the stipulated rule of the fixture, not a rule readers must follow

cases.description: raw field, exclusive, on every target instance
raw field shared with another term
raw field missing from one target instance
named in prose only; on no instance
on every target instance and on one other-term instance

a key present on every record of every term (None off the target), populated on the target only: TAG reads presence here, so NO; a reader reading applicability would say YES. The fixture fixes TAG to presence and records the other reading as an alternative.
